title: Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement: Conditions for Retention Concessions on Noticed Increases
content:
**Former opening clause — no longer in force.** The clause under which a tenant who calls about a noticed increase may be given a retention concession giving back the retention concession share of the class of the increase, rounded down to the cent, with the same effective date as the increase and linked to it, is **no longer in force**; it has been superseded by the current basis for retention concessions.

The following conditions of the Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement remain in force for every retention concession.

| Condition | Rule | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| Request window | A retention concession may be granted only when the handling date is not later than the increase notice date plus the request window of the class. The window counts calendar days starting the day after the notice date, and the last counted day is included. | Notice date of the increase |
| Tenure | The tenant must have held the agreement for at least the minimum tenure of the class in whole calendar months counted from the start date. Tenure months are whole calendar months from the start date to the same day of the later month, or that month's last day when the day does not exist. | Start date of the agreement |
| One per increase | Each increase receives at most one concession or rescission. | Rent change history linked to that increase |
| Rolling allowance | Concessions on the agreement in the last 365 days must be below the concession allowance of the class. The 365 days are calendar days ending on the handling date, that date included, and the count is of retention concessions whose notice date falls inside. | Rent change history |
| Exclusions | An increase already in effect, an agreement with a move-out notice, and a defective increase (which is rescinded instead) get no concession. | Effective date, move-out notice, the increase rules |
| Floor | A concession never lowers the rent below the rent before the increase. | Previous rent on the increase |

### Boundary cases (hypothetical dates)

- Request window of 30 days, increase noticed 10 April: days run from 11 April and the 30th day is 10 May; a concession may be granted on 10 May and not on 11 May.
- Minimum tenure of 12 months, start date 31 January of one year: 12 whole months are reached on 31 January of the next year; on 30 January of that year the tenant holds 11 whole months.
- Allowance of 1: a concession noticed 300 days before the handling date leaves the count at 1, which is not below 1; one noticed 366 days before is outside the window.

superseded_clauses: A tenant who calls about a noticed increase may be given a retention_concession that gives back retention_concession_pct_of_increase of the increase, rounded down to the cent, with the same effective date as the increase and its source_rate_change_id pointing at it.
